reason: I run one or two chairs and cut most of the hair myself, so I already know who is in the chair and what is in the drawer. ₹4,999 upfront plus ₹999 every month forever is too much for something my notebook and WhatsApp already do for free.
objection: It is a monthly subscription that never ends, and if the app stops working on a busy Sunday, who will come and fix it? Most of these features are for bigger salons with many staff, not a shop like mine.
would_change_my_mind: A one-time price with no monthly fee, around ₹3,000, with a phone number that actually answers on Sundays.
